{"consolidated_memory":"FLAKY JOB IN CI PIPELINE (build/ci/pipeline.yml) - FOUR SEPARATE FIXES

This is a series of four separate occasions where the same flaky job problem in the CI pipeline was diagnosed and fixed. Each occasion had a different root cause and trigger.

**OCCASION 1: [2026-01-29] - Race in Lazy Initialisation**
- File: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system side)
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Signal: one job failing on a minority of runs
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR: #4650 on branch fix/flaky-job-1
- Repro method: rerun the same commit ten times
- Result: job finished in 35 minutes instead of 2 hours

**OCCASION 2: [2026-02-04] - Unbounded Retry Loop**
- File: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system side)
- Trigger: two requests raced on the same key
- Signal: one job failing on a minority of runs
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #8388 on branch fix/flaky-job-2
- Repro method: rerun the same commit ten times
- Stack: YAML; covering check is pipeline replay job
- Result: reclaimed 96 GB of blob storage

**OCCASION 3: [2026-07-08] - Missing Unicode Normalisation**
- File: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system side)
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Signal: one job failing on a minority of runs
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR: #8804 on branch fix/flaky-job-3
- Repro method: rerun the same commit ten times
- Stack: YAML; covering check is pipeline replay job
- Result: backlog cleared 26 minutes after the deploy

**OCCASION 4: [2026-08-15] - Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields**
- File: build/ci/pipeline.yml (build system side)
- Trigger: after the client had already retried once
- Signal: one job failing on a minority of runs
- Root cause: the serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR: #8972 on branch fix/flaky-job-4
- Repro method: rerun the same commit ten times
- Stack: YAML; covering check is pipeline replay job
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 33 days running"}
